title: Stiletto Sailing Cruises
specs: 30-foot catamarans are fast, stable, and smooth sailing vessels
Views include Ephraim shoreline, Eagle Bluff, Peninsula State Park, Horseshoe Island, and offshore islands
No prior skill or physical ability needed
Each boat holds up to 6 passengers plus captain

options.detail: Parasailing over Door County Peninsula with three height options

includes: US Coast Guard Licensed Captain and crew
blurb: Guests sail on 30-foot catamarans for 1.5 to 2 hours viewing the Ephraim shoreline, Eagle Bluff, Peninsula State Park, Horseshoe Island, and offshore islands. Cruises are on stable, fast catamarans with cushioned bench seating and trampolines. Life jackets are provided for all ages and no prior experience is needed.
extraNote: Reservations recommended; phone reservations up to 14 days in advance with credit card to secure spot · 48-hour cancellation policy for full refund of deposit · Full charge for cancellations less than 48 hours or no-shows · If operator cancels due to weather, no charge and rescheduling encouraged · Accepts Cash, Debit, MasterCard, Visa, Discover, American Express, Travelers Check · Ephraim's South Shore Pier, across the street from Wilson's Ice Cream Parlor · Mid-May through Mid-October
